lines.text: Many learners say: She don't like coffee.

native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She don't like coffee.”. O certo é “She doesn't like coffee.”. É um erro muito comum, até para quem já estuda há anos. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “doesn't”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She don't like coffee.”. The right way is “She doesn't like coffee.”. A very common mistake, even after years of study. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
